name: Xīxuegui Yu Xiawucha
source:
The girl Cecily, who lost her way in the forest, was taken in by the mysterious man Kyle. Please strive to explore the secrets of this house within 12 days, otherwise there may be a tragic ending

[From [url=https://nancyajuan.itch.io/vampires-and-afternoon-tea]Itch.io[/url]]

在森林中迷路的女孩塞西莉被神秘男子凯尔收留。请争取在12天内探索这所房子的秘密，否则可能会有悲惨的结局
